collection_method: Exact Git source archive imported in existing unchanged locked package environments; list_tools only; no lifespan or tools executed.

tools.name: content_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze content (file, URL, or text) with any instruction.

Provide exactly one of file_path, url, or text. Uses Gemini's structured
output for reliable JSON responses. Pass a custom output_schema to control
the response shape, or use the default ContentResult schema.

instruction.default: Provide a comprehensive analysis of this content.
instruction.description: What to analyze — e.g. 'summarize key findings', 'extract methodology', 'list all citations'

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the response. If omitted, uses default ContentResult schema.

tools.name: content_batch_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze multiple content files from a directory or explicit file list.

Supports two modes: 'compare' sends all files to Gemini in a single call
for cross-document analysis, 'individual' analyzes each file separately
with bounded concurrency (3 parallel calls).

instruction.default: Provide a comprehensive analysis of these documents.
instruction.description: What to analyze — e.g. 'compare methodologies', 'summarize each document', 'extract key findings'

directory.description: Directory to scan for content files

file_paths.description: Explicit list of file paths to analyze

glob_pattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files within directory

mode.description: 'compare' for cross-document analysis in one call, 'individual' for separate per-file analysis

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for each result

tools.name: content_extract
tools.description:
Extract structured data from content using a JSON Schema.

Uses Gemini's response_json_schema for guaranteed structured output.

schema.description: JSON Schema defining the extraction structure

tools.name: infra_cache
tools.description: Manage the analysis cache — stats, list, clear, or inspect context cache state.

content_id.description: Scope clear to a specific content ID

auth_token.description: Optional infra auth token (required when INFRA_ADMIN_TOKEN is configured)

tools.name: infra_configure
tools.description:
Reconfigure the server at runtime — preset, model, thinking level, or temperature.

Changes take effect immediately for all subsequent tool calls.

model.description: Gemini model ID override (takes precedence over preset)

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for models that support it (not 3.6+ Flash)

auth_token.description: Optional infra auth token (required when INFRA_ADMIN_TOKEN is configured)

tools.name: knowledge_ask
tools.description:
Ask a question and get an AI-generated answer grounded in stored knowledge.

Uses Weaviate AsyncQueryAgent in ask mode to synthesize an answer from
objects across knowledge collections, with source citations.

query.description: Question to answer from stored knowledge

tools.name: knowledge_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a single object by UUID from a knowledge collection.

tools.name: knowledge_ingest
tools.description:
Manually insert data into a knowledge collection.

Properties are validated against the collection schema — unknown keys
are rejected with allowed name:type pairs.

Tip: call knowledge_schema(collection=...) first to see expected properties.

tools.name: knowledge_query
tools.description:
[DEPRECATED] Search knowledge store using natural language.

Deprecated: Use knowledge_search instead, which now includes Cohere reranking
and Flash summarization for better results with lower token usage.

Uses Weaviate AsyncQueryAgent in search mode for intelligent object retrieval.

tools.name: knowledge_related
tools.description: Find semantically related objects using near-object vector search.

collection.description: Collection the source object belongs to.

tools.name: knowledge_schema
tools.description:
Return property schemas for knowledge collections.

Reads from local CollectionDef objects — no Weaviate connection needed.
Use this before knowledge_ingest to discover expected property names and types.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description:
Search across knowledge collections using hybrid, semantic, or keyword mode.

Searches specified or all collections. Results are merged and sorted by score.
Filters are collection-aware: conditions are skipped for collections
that lack the relevant property.

search_type.description: Search mode: hybrid (BM25+vector), semantic (vector only), keyword (BM25 only)

tools.name: knowledge_stats
tools.description: Get object counts per collection, optionally grouped by a property.

group_by.description: Group counts by a text property (e.g. evidence_tier, source_tool)

tools.name: research_assess_evidence
tools.description: Assess a claim against sources, returning evidence tier and confidence.

tools.name: research_author_search
tools.description:
Search for academic authors on Semantic Scholar.

Returns author profiles with affiliation, paper count, citation count,
and h-index.

tools.name: research_deep
tools.description:
Run multi-phase deep research with evidence-tier labeling.

Phases: Scope Definition -> Evidence Collection -> Synthesis.
Every claim is labeled CONFIRMED, STRONG INDICATOR, INFERENCE,
SPECULATION, or UNKNOWN.

tools.name: research_document
tools.description:
Run multi-phase deep research grounded in source documents.

Phases: Document Mapping -> Evidence Extraction -> Cross-Reference -> Synthesis.
Every claim is labeled with evidence tiers and cited back to source documents.

instruction.description: Research question or analysis instruction for the documents

urls.description: URLs to PDF documents (downloaded and uploaded to Gemini)

scope.description: Research depth -- quick, moderate, deep, comprehensive.

tools.name: research_paper_citations
tools.description: Get citations or references for a paper.

tools.name: research_paper_details
tools.description:
Get detailed metadata for a specific paper.

Accepts Semantic Scholar IDs, DOIs (prefix with DOI:), or ArXiv IDs
(prefix with ArXiv:).

paper_id.description: Paper ID: S2 ID, DOI (prefix 'DOI:10.xxx'), or ArXiv (prefix 'ArXiv:2301.xxx')

tools.name: research_paper_recommendations
tools.description:
Get paper recommendations based on seed papers.

Uses Semantic Scholar's recommendation engine to find related papers.

seed_paper_ids.description: List of S2 paper IDs to base recommendations on

tools.name: research_paper_search
tools.description:
Search academic papers on Semantic Scholar.

Returns papers with metadata, abstracts, citation counts, and TL;DR
summaries. Supports filtering by field of study, year range, and
open access availability.

fields_of_study.description: Filter by fields (e.g. Computer Science, Medicine)

year_range.description: Year filter: '2020' for single year, '2020-2024' for range, '2020-' for since

tools.name: research_plan
tools.description:
Generate a multi-agent research orchestration plan.

Returns a phased blueprint with task decomposition and model assignments.
Does NOT spawn agents — provides the blueprint for the caller.

tools.name: research_web
tools.description:
Launch a Gemini Deep Research Agent for autonomous web-grounded research.

The agent plans its own research, searches the web (~80-160 queries),
reads sources, and produces a cited markdown report. Runs in background;
poll with research_web_status. Provider usage is billed; runtime varies.

topic.description: Precise research brief — the more detailed, the better results

output_format.description: Report structure/format instructions (e.g. 'executive summary + data tables')

tools.name: research_web_cancel
tools.description:
Cancel a running Deep Research task.

Sends a cancel request to the Interactions API and cleans up local
tracking state. Useful for stopping a task before further provider usage.

tools.name: research_web_followup
tools.description:
Ask a follow-up question about a completed Deep Research report.

Uses previous_interaction_id to maintain context from the original
research. Synchronous — follow-ups are fast (no background needed).

interaction_id.description: Completed interaction ID to follow up on

question.description: Follow-up question about the research report

tools.name: research_web_status
tools.description:
Poll or retrieve a Deep Research task.

Returns the full report with sources when completed, or current status
if still in progress. Auto-stores completed reports to Weaviate.

tools.name: video_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze a video (YouTube URL or local file) with any instruction.

Provide exactly one of url or file_path. Uses Gemini's structured output
for reliable JSON responses. Pass a custom output_schema to control the
response shape, or use the default VideoResult schema.

When strict_contract=True, runs the full contract pipeline: analysis with
strict Pydantic models, parallel strategy/concept-map generation, artifact
rendering, and quality gates. Returns richer output but takes longer.

anyOf.description: Path to a local video file (mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv, mpeg, wmv, 3gpp)

file_path.description: Path to a local video file.

instruction.default: Provide a comprehensive analysis of this video.
instruction.description: What to analyze — e.g. 'summarize key points', 'extract all CLI commands shown', 'list all recipes and ingredients'

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the response. If omitted, uses default VideoResult schema.

strict_contract.description: Enable strict contract pipeline with quality gates, artifact rendering, and semantic validation. Produces richer output with strategy report, concept map, and HTML/Markdown artifacts.

tools.name: video_batch_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze all video files in a directory concurrently.

Scans the directory for supported video files (mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv,
mpeg, wmv, 3gpp), then analyzes each with the given instruction using
bounded concurrency (3 parallel Gemini calls).

directory.description: Path to a directory containing video files

instruction.default: Provide a comprehensive analysis of this video.
instruction.description: What to analyze in each video

glob_pattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files within the directory

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for each video's response

tools.name: video_comments
tools.description:
Fetch top YouTube comments sorted by relevance.

Returns comment text, like count, and author for each comment.
Costs 1+ YouTube API units, 0 Gemini units.

max_comments.description: Maximum comments to fetch (sorted by relevance)

tools.name: video_continue_session
tools.description: Continue analysis within an existing video session.

tools.name: video_create_session
tools.description:
Create a persistent session for multi-turn video exploration.

Provide exactly one of url or file_path. When ``download=True`` and the
source is YouTube, the video is downloaded via yt-dlp, uploaded to the
Gemini File API, and context-cached for fast multi-turn use.

anyOf.description: Path to a local video file (mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv, mpeg, wmv, 3gpp)

file_path.description: Path to a local video file.

download.description: Download YouTube video locally for cached multi-turn sessions. Slower startup (~2 min) but faster and cheaper per turn. Requires yt-dlp installed.

tools.name: video_metadata
tools.description:
Fetch YouTube video metadata without Gemini analysis.

Returns title, description, view/like/comment counts, duration,
tags, channel info, category, and language. Costs 1 YouTube API
unit, 0 Gemini units.

tools.name: video_playlist
tools.description:
Get video IDs and titles from a YouTube playlist.

Results can be passed to video_analyze for batch analysis.
Costs 1 YouTube API unit per page (max 50 items/page).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web using Gemini's built-in Google Search grounding.

tools.name: explainer_create
tools.description: Create a new explainer video project.

tools.name: explainer_factcheck
tools.description: Run fact-checking on the project's script content.

tools.name: explainer_feedback
tools.description: Add feedback to a project for iterative improvement.

feedback.description: Feedback text to add to the project

tools.name: explainer_generate
tools.description: Run the full explainer pipeline (or a subset of steps).

tools.name: explainer_inject
tools.description:
Inject content into a project's input directory.

Writes content directly to the project's ``input/`` directory without
calling the CLI. Use this to feed research output into the pipeline.

content.description: Content to inject (markdown, text, or research output)

tools.name: explainer_list
tools.description:
List all explainer projects with completion status.

Returns:
    Dict with projects list and total count.

tools.name: explainer_music
tools.description: Generate background music for the video.

tools.name: explainer_refine
tools.description: Refine a pipeline step's output for better quality.

tools.name: explainer_render
tools.description:
Render the explainer video (blocking — waits for completion).

For long renders, prefer ``explainer_render_start`` + ``explainer_render_poll``.

tools.name: explainer_render_poll
tools.description: Check the status of a background render job.

tools.name: explainer_render_start
tools.description:
Start a background render and return immediately with a job ID.

Poll progress with ``explainer_render_poll``.

tools.name: explainer_short
tools.description: Generate a short-form video from an existing project.

tools.name: explainer_sound
tools.description: Analyze scenes for sound cues or generate sound effects.

tools.name: explainer_status
tools.description:
Check the status of an explainer project.

Scans the project directory for completed pipeline steps without
calling the CLI.

tools.name: explainer_step
tools.description: Run a single pipeline step.

tools.name: agent_generate_scenes
tools.description:
Generate all Remotion scene components for a project in parallel.

Reads script.json and voiceover/manifest.json from the project,
builds per-scene prompts, runs them through Claude in parallel via
the Agent SDK, extracts TSX code from responses, and writes scene
files + index.ts to disk.

Partial failure is supported: if 5/7 scenes succeed, those 5 are
written and indexed; the 2 failures are reported in ``errors``.
Failed scenes can be retried with ``agent_generate_single_scene``.

project_id.description: Project identifier under the explainer projects directory

tools.name: agent_generate_single_scene
tools.description:
Generate or regenerate a single Remotion scene component.

Useful for retrying failed scenes from ``agent_generate_scenes``
or regenerating a specific scene after script changes.

project_id.description: Project identifier under the explainer projects directory
